roleZh: 引出上下桥臂的中点，连接相线负载。
roleEn: Brings out the high-side / low-side midpoint to the phase load.
featuresZh: AC 与 P/N 的电气节点不同；演示模型不代表具体额定电流。
featuresEn: AC is a distinct electrical node from P/N. This model does not specify a current rating.
materialZh: 铜；表面处理按连接方案选择。
materialEn: Copper; surface finish depends on the joint design.
